title: Book Two · Chapter 70: The First Page Is His
story:
On Monday, Ronan takes his birthday book to school. He does not put it with the class work. He keeps it under his own reading book, with the blue bike picture inside.

Leo sees the corner of the cover at lunch.

“New?”

“For my birthday.”

“Can I see?”

Ronan opens to the bike. Leo leans closer. He points toward the bell. His finger does not touch the paper.

“That is a very large bell.”

“It is important.”

“Can the bike fit under it?”

Ronan laughs. He draws a tiny rider beside the bike. The rider's feet almost reach both wheels.

Leo has a story idea about the big bell. He wants to write it on the next page. Ronan closes the book a little.

“I want to use that page.”

“Only a few lines.”

“I know. But it is my book.”

Leo's face changes. He pulls his hand back. Ronan wants to take back his words. He knows this feeling. He wants Leo to be pleased with the book. He also wants its clean pages for himself.

Jun puts a scrap of paper on the desk.

“Use this,” he says to Leo. “The back is clean.”

Leo takes it. He writes a line about a bell too big for a small bike. Then he shows Ronan. Ronan reads the line. He asks Leo about a picture. Leo agrees. Ronan draws it on the scrap.

The bell in this picture is bigger than the rider's head. Jun draws a little ladder beside it.

“He can reach the bell now,” he says.

Leo adds a bird at the top. They cannot fit much more on the paper.

Ronan keeps his book. Leo folds the shared scrap and puts it in his own bag. Jun returns to his lunch.

At home, Ronan tells Mum about the page. She is sorting buttons by size. Her own blue skirt is over the back of her chair.

“Was Leo angry?” she asks.

“For a little while.”

“And now?”

“He has the big bell story.”

Ronan opens his book to the empty page. There is a rough mark near the top from his pencil. He presses it with his thumb. It does not go away.

He draws a small bird beside the mark. Then he gives the bird a long tail. On the other side of the table, Mum tips the large buttons into their tin. The sound makes him lift his head. He draws a button under the bird. Now his picture has a new shape.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

own＝自己的；rough＝粗糙的；press＝按压。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan为什么不愿把新本子给Leo？
2. 两个朋友怎样分享阅读又保留各自东西？

## 读句子

**Ronan / keeps / his book.** Ronan／保留／他的本子。
